description: This file implements functions for managing OVSDB tables, including initialization, JSON conversion, CRUD operations, monitoring, and update callbacks, specifically for the 'ovsdb_table' structure in the context of the OneWifi project.

methods.name: onewifi_ovsdb_table_init
methods.description: Initializes an ovsdb_table_t structure with provided schema and callback functions.
